items.title: ONE 7 India Unveils New Brand Identity and Logo, Marking a New Chapter in Its Journey - The Tribune
items.raw_summary: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], August 1: In the new activities and developments, the company presents itself and launches for the first time in its brand identity and corporate logo with success. The new name captures the change in the brands identity, its vision and enhanced mission of creating a contemporary, innovative and trusted Indian technology accessory brand.
items.title_pt: ONE 7 India Revela Nova Identidade de Marca e Logo, Marcando Novo Capítulo em Sua Jornada
items.summary_pt: Empresa de tecnologia lança nova identidade visual e nome para refletir visão contemporânea e inovadora.
items.pme_pt: Demonstra importância de alinhar novo nome, logo e narrativa com missão evolutiva — modelo claro para reposicionamento completo.

items.title: How JSW Paints is rethinking marketing with AI and creator-led campaigns - CNBC TV18
items.raw_summary: JSW Paints CMO Rohit Talwar shares how the company is rethinking brand building with AI, creator-led marketing and a sharper media strategy. Watch the video to know more about his views on authenticity, CTV, IPL and the future of marketing.
items.title_pt: Como JSW Paints está repensando marketing com IA e campanhas lideradas por criadores
items.summary_pt: CMO compartilha estratégia de marca com IA, marketing de criadores e mídia assertiva.
items.pme_pt: Ajuda a avaliar se a marca está usando IA e criadores de forma autêntica para reposicionar a percepção no mercado, útil para revisar direção estratégica contínua.

items.title: Lawyers barred from making reels, memes in court premises: Bar Council of India enforces social media code ... - Bhaskar English
items.raw_summary: Follow Bhaskar English for latest updates on BCI social media code in Rajasthan. Under the new rules, lawyers will not be allowed to make reels on social media, record court proceedings or use their professional identity for personal branding. Lawyers violating these rules will face disciplinary action under the Advocates Act, 1961.
items.title_pt: Advogados barrados de fazer reels e memes em dependências judiciais: Bar Council of India reforça código de mídia social
items.summary_pt: Novas regras proíbem advogados de usar redes sociais para branding pessoal em contextos profissionais.
